headline: Dexco Reports 142 Million Real Loss in Third Quarter
summary: Dexco reported a net loss of R$142 million in the third quarter, impacted by the decommissioning of factories, bringing its year-to-date net loss to R$55.4 million.
why: Dexco is a major manufacturer of construction materials; its financial results reflect the health of the housing and construction sector.

impacts.name: Dexco
impacts.why: Net losses and factory decommissioning costs are negative indicators for equity performance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
